info.title: RetinaCare API
info.description:
Backend for diabetic-retinopathy screening: patients, doctors, appointments, chat, AI analysis of fundus images and PDF reports.

**Responses.** Successful JSON responses are wrapped as `{ "message": string, "data": ... }`. File endpoints return the raw file. Errors use `ErrorResponse`.

**Language.** Messages and validation errors are returned in English or Arabic, chosen by `?language=`, then the `x-language` header, then `Accept-Language`.

**Ids.** All ids are 24-character MongoDB ObjectIds; a malformed id returns 400.

**Rate limits.** 120 requests per minute per user by default; stricter limits are listed on the endpoints that have them.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Accounts, tokens and email verification. Access tokens go in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

tags.name: User
tags.description: The signed-in user: profile, avatar and push-notification devices.

tags.name: Patient
tags.description: Patient records. `{id}` is the patient profile id, not the user id.

tags.name: Doctor
tags.description: Clinic profile, license verification and the doctor’s patient list. Until an admin approves the license, a doctor can only use the `me/clinic` and `me/verification` routes.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Admin only. Review doctor licenses (approve or reject, the admin has the final decision) and enable or disable accounts. The first admin is created at startup from ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD.

tags.name: Appointment
tags.description: Doctors publish availability as slots; patients book one appointment per day. Cancelling or rescheduling is a request the doctor approves or rejects.

tags.name: Chat
tags.description:
REST endpoints for history and attachments.

### Real-time chat (socket.io)

Namespace `/chat`. Send the access token in the handshake:

```js
const socket = io('http://localhost:9090/chat', { auth: { token: accessToken } });
```

Only active doctors and patients with an assignment can chat. Every event is authenticated; failures arrive as an `exception` event (or the ack): `{ status: 'error', statusCode, message, event }`.

**Client → server** (all acknowledged)

| Event | Payload | Ack |
|---|---|---|
| `join_conversation` | `{ conversationId }` | `{ status: 'ok', conversationId }` |
| `leave_conversation` | `{ conversationId }` | `{ status: 'ok', conversationId }` |
| `send_message` | `{ conversationId, message?, attachments?: [{ name?, data }], clientId? }` — `data` is base64 or bytes; JPEG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, 5 MB each, at most 4 | `{ status: 'ok', message: ChatMessage }` |
| `typing` | `{ conversationId, isTyping }` | `{ status: 'ok' }` |
| `read` | `{ conversationId, messageId? }` | `{ status: 'ok', count, upTo }` |

**Server → client**

| Event | Payload |
|---|---|
| `new_message` | `ChatMessage` (to both participants) |
| `typing` | `{ conversationId, userId, isTyping }` (to the other participant in the room) |
| `read` | `{ conversationId, userId, upTo, count }` |

A push notification is sent when the recipient is not in the conversation room.

tags.name: Analysis
tags.description:
AI screening of fundus images in two stages: **stage 1** detects diabetic retinopathy (available now), **stage 2** grades its severity 0–4 (shown as unavailable until the grading model is deployed).

Flow: upload → `pending` → `processing` → `completed` / `failed` (retry) → doctor review → report.

tags.name: Report
tags.description: PDF reports. A report needs a completed analysis, the doctor’s review and a note. Drafts can be edited; sending locks the report and notifies the patient, who can then download it.

tags.name: Notification
tags.description: In-app notification inbox (also pushed through FCM to registered devices).
